changes.summary: Clerk Directory Sync connection billing starts 2027-01-01 (same ladder as SSO: 1 included on Pro/Business, then $75 / $60 bands). Announced on clerk.com/pricing.

Added Auth0 for Startups (auth0.com/startups, read 2026-10-31): eligible startups (venture-backed with less than $5M in funding, less than $1M ARR, less than two years from incorporation; not existing paid Auth0/Okta customers or past members) get one year of the B2B Professional plan free, up to 100,000 MAU with 5 Enterprise Connections and inbound SCIM. Shown as a note on the SSO guide, Auth0 vendor page and every Auth0 comparison with the month-13 list price (B2B Professional with 3 SSO connections: $800/mo at 1,000 MAU, $1,500 at 5,000, $2,400 at 10,000; above 10,000 MAU contact sales). Rankings still use list prices.

Correction: SSO and B2B answers now include organization/tenant fees and caps read from vendor pages on 2026-10-31. Clerk: 100 monthly retained orgs and 20 members per org free; above either, the B2B Authentication add-on is $100/mo ($85 annual), then $1/mo per org (101–1,000), $0.90 (1,001–10,000), $0.75 (10,001–100,000), $0.60 (100,001+). Auth0: Free 5 and B2C plans 10 organizations; B2B unlimited. Descope: 10/35/100 active tenants, then $1 per tenant on Pro and Growth. Kinde: Free 5 orgs, paid 50 then $0.50/$0.47/$0.43. Logto: Organizations add-on $48/mo. Each SSO connection now counts as 1 customer organization. Before, Clerk vs Auth0 at 10k users with 1 SSO connection read '$300/yr less than Clerk'; it is $1,500/yr (Clerk Pro $125/mo incl. the $100/mo add-on for 200-member orgs).

Added Firebase Auth / Identity Platform (no cost to 50k MAU, then $0.0055→$0.0025/MAU bands; SAML/OIDC $0.015/MAU after 50) and Descope (Free 7.5k MAU; Pro from $249/mo with 10k MAU + $0.05/MAU; Growth from $799/mo with 25k MAU), read from their official pricing pages. New guide: what self-hosting Better Auth / Auth.js costs instead.

Clerk publishes a new enterprise SSO connection band: connections 101–250 now cost $48/mo each (was "Contact us" for 101+). Earlier bands are unchanged: 1 included, $75/mo each for 2–15, $60/mo each for 16–100; 251+ is contact sales.

Correction: our earlier Auth0 data (2026-10-30) listed paid tiers only at 500 MAU and called higher volumes and B2B “custom”. That was wrong — Auth0 publishes MAU tiers: B2C Essentials $70 (1k) to $3,500 (50k)/mo, B2C Professional to $3,200 (20k), B2B Essentials $150 (500) to $3,800 (20k) with 3 SSO connections, B2B Professional $800 to $2,400 (10k) with 5. Billing rounds up to the next tier; yearly = 11× monthly; extra SSO connections $100/mo. Not an Auth0 price change — our omission, now fixed.
Initial ledger seeded from official pricing pages (Clerk, Auth0, Cognito, WorkOS, Stytch, Logto, Kinde, Supabase Auth).
